question: How much precipitation will San Francisco International Airport record on Thanksgiving Day (November 26, 2026)?

calls.reasoning: Climatology: late-Nov SFO measurable-rain day frequency ~22%, right-skewed amounts. CPC hazards outlook (issued Nov 15) puts a moderate risk of heavy precip/high winds over N. California Nov 24-25 tied to atmospheric-river activity before Thanksgiving, with slight risks lingering Nov 23-29; Fox Weather (Nov 10) showed the West still showery on Thanksgiving. Main AR timing is Nov 24-25, so Nov 26 may be post-frontal showers or a lull; day-10 timing error is large. Raised P(measurable) from ~22% to ~54%, with the mass weighted toward light-moderate amounts. No human market found (Polymarket candidates are SF temperature contracts only).
